subject.title: fix(plugins): preserve agent harnesses across empty-plugin-scope reloads

question: When an activating reload resolves to an empty plugin scope, should any agent harness survive, and if so which ownership class is allowed to remain executable?
rationale: Current registrations include `ownerPluginId`, but this patch restores all entries, so choosing between full plugin disablement, a core-only class, or preventing accidental empty scopes defines both lifecycle and security behavior.

options.title: Preserve only core-owned harnesses
options.body: Define an explicit non-plugin ownership class, clear all plugin-owned entries, and test both survival and removal semantics.

options.title: Prevent accidental empty scopes
options.body: Keep empty activation destructive and repair the caller or activation plan that incorrectly omits required plugin IDs.

options.title: Restore all prior harnesses
options.body: Accept that plugin-owned executable harnesses remain active despite an empty registry and document that compatibility contract.

recommendation.title: Preserve only core-owned harnesses
recommendation.body: Define an explicit non-plugin ownership class, clear all plugin-owned entries, and test both survival and removal semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent history is closest to explicit plugin-scope and empty-scope loader semantics.
